summary: STAK Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing its unaudited financial results for the first half of fiscal year 2026. The filing contains routine earnings data, including revenues of $19.2 million, net income of $1.8 million, and EPS of $0.14. There is no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. This is a standard periodic financial report from a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US earnings release. No special-situation event is present.
